state.paragraph: During the evening of December 12, 2014, Bidder 2 submitted an offer of $81.50 per share, in cash. Representatives of J.P. Morgan confirmed via a conversation with Bidder 2 on the evening of December 12, 2014 that $81.50 per share was its best and final offer. The Buyer Group initially submitted an oral offer of $82.50 per share, in cash, but stated that it was working to increase the offer within the next few hours. Later in the evening, the Buyer Group submitted a best and final offer of $83.00 per share, in cash. In addition, each bidder submitted a revised draft of the merger agreement and other transaction agreements, and copies of their respective financing commitment documents. The versions submitted by the Buyer Group were, with few exceptions, in substantially executable form.

ledger_rows.Note: Approved Buyer Group’s request to work with Longview; they formed a rollover-support relationship but not a separate bidding group.
Improved-bid deadline; Bidder 2 and Buyer Group submitted revised bids that evening.
Submitted revised agreements and financing commitments; later confirmed $81.50 was best and final.
Oral revision; said it was working to increase the offer within hours. Revised agreements and financing commitments accompanied the final sequence.
Best and final cash offer; revised documents were, with few exceptions, substantially executable and financing commitments were supplied.
Selected Buyer Group and approved its merger, subject to satisfactory resolution of remaining agreement points.
Buyer Group’s $83 offer was selected over Bidder 2’s standing $81.50 best-and-final offer.
$83.00 per share in cash; Longview voting agreement and related transaction agreements also executed.
Issued a press release announcing the signed transaction.

bid.instructions: `paragraph` reports that a bidder submits, revises, confirms or reaffirms a priced proposal, indication of interest or offer for the company. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.
